'''Nalan Cheel''' was a [[Bith]] [[musician]] who played a [[bandfill]] as a regular member of the [[band]] [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin]], Cheel and the other members of the band played at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] when [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visited trying to find a [[pilot]] to take them to the planet [[Alderaan]].<ref name="ANH" />

{{Char-stub}}
